subject.title: Allow more than 3 providers in the Overview tab (compact density mode)

question: Should CodexBar support an opt-in compact Overview mode with more than three selected providers, and if so what cap and secondary-window disclosure behavior should be the supported contract?
rationale: The request adds persistent settings and changes which provider data is visible at a glance; source inspection confirms the current limit but cannot choose the intended density, cap, or disclosure UX.

options.title: Compact mode plus higher cap
options.body: Add an opt-in dense row style, keep the current layout as default, and allow roughly six to eight providers with accessible expansion for additional quota windows.

options.title: Raise cap only
options.body: Increase the existing selector limit while retaining full provider rows, accepting additional scrolling and variable popover height.

options.title: Keep three-provider design
options.body: Retain the current bounded Overview and direct users to provider tabs for additional detail.

recommendation.title: Compact mode plus higher cap
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in dense row style, keep the current layout as default, and allow roughly six to eight providers with accessible expansion for additional quota windows.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository vision assigns new-feature direction to sign-off, and the repository owner is the clearest available decision owner.
